_about: SYNTHETIC. An invented household (Sam, Robin and a cat called Mochi) written for this repo. Nothing here was heard in a real home. Days are offsets from 'today' so the fixtures never age out.
profile: - Sam lives with Robin and a cat called Mochi.
- Bakes sourdough on Sundays; practises the cello most evenings before dinner.
- Grows tomatoes and basil on the balcony.
- Runs on Tuesday and Friday mornings.

Mochi's vet appointment is the first Thursday of the month.
